profiles.notes: Shared eligibility, rank conversions and programme-linked requirements for 2027 international school-leaver entry.

requirements.label: GCE A-level · score calculation
requirements.details: ANU selects the stronger rank from the best three or four A-level subjects. Grade weights are A*=6, A=5, B=4, C=3, D=2 and E=1. Take the exams in one academic year, with up to one subject from the preceding or following year.

source.title: ANU GCE A Levels, aggregate and timing

requirements.label: AP · direct entry evidence
requirements.details: Complete a US or Chinese high-school diploma and present three or four AP exams over a maximum of two years. Each counted result must be at least grade 3. Exclude Calculus AB subgrades. Have College Board send the official report directly to ANU.

source.title: ANU AP direct entry, effective from Semester 1 2026

requirements.label: International application · records and translations
requirements.details: Submit academic records with the grading scale, evidence of secondary completion and proof of English proficiency. Supply applicable programme-specific documents. Include a complete authorised translation for originals in other languages.

source.title: ANU international documentation requirements

requirements.label: Predicted IB, GCE A-level and HKDSE results
requirements.details: The published documentation policy accepts predicted results for Semester 2 applications. Applicants using this route must provide the official final transcript for enrolment verification.

source.title: ANU international documentation, predicted-results route

requirements.label: 2027 direct international application and offer deadlines
requirements.details: The published Semester 1 application deadline is 15 December 2026. Accept by 15 January 2027 if overseas or 31 January 2027 if in Australia. For Semester 2, apply by 15 May 2027 and accept by 30 June if overseas or 10 July if in Australia. Special selection deadlines may differ.

source.title: ANU international applications, 2027 key dates

requirements.label: Direct application · preferences and fee
requirements.details: Rank up to three programmes in the direct application. ANU considers the highest eligible preference for an offer. Each submitted application has an AUD 150 application fee.

source.title: ANU international applications, direct submission and preferences

requirements.label: Undergraduate English tests · study commencing in 2027
requirements.details: IELTS Academic or UKVI Academic: 6.5 overall and 6.0 in each skill. TOEFL iBT: 81 overall, Reading 16, Writing 19, Listening 16, Speaking 19. Tests from 21 January 2026 must use TOEFL iBT Australia. PTE Academic or PTE Academic UKVI: 64 overall and 60 in each skill. Cambridge C1 Advanced: 169 overall, Reading 163, Writing 170, Listening 163 and Speaking 179. Michigan English Test: 58 overall, Reading 55, Writing 57, Listening 56 and Speaking 48. LanguageCert Academic: 67 overall, Reading 60, Writing 64, Listening 57 and Speaking 70.

source.title: ANU policy ANUP_000408, undergraduate English tests in Table 2

requirements.label: Undergraduate English tests · test centre and validity
requirements.details: Use an in-person test at an official centre under the policy’s test rules. The usual validity window is two years before application. A four-year window is possible with at least one full-time equivalent year of subsequent education in English within the last two years. Check the individual test rules before combining results.

source.title: ANU policy ANUP_000408, clauses 13–15

requirements.label: International secondary qualifications and selection rank
requirements.details: ANU uses the applicant’s qualification or study sequence to calculate a selection rank out of 99.95. Programme prerequisites, English proficiency and additional selection can affect eligibility and admission.

source.title: ANU international assessment, undergraduate selection rank

requirements.label: Mathematics prerequisite · recognised IB subjects
requirements.details: For the IB route the programme accepts Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation HL, or Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches at SL or HL. Australian equivalents include ACT Mathematical Methods (Major) and NSW Mathematics Advanced. Programme handbooks list other equivalents.

source.title: ANU Programs and Courses 2027, BACTS: mathematics prerequisites

requirements.label: Chemistry prerequisite · recognised IB subjects
requirements.details: IB Chemistry at SL or HL is accepted. Applicants without equivalent chemistry should ask ANU for academic advice. ANU advertises a February chemistry bridging course.

source.title: ANU Programs and Courses 2027, BBIOT: chemistry prerequisite

requirements.label: Mathematics assumed knowledge
requirements.details: The programme has no formal mathematics prerequisite. ANU assumes preparation comparable to ACT Mathematical Methods (Major) or NSW Mathematics Advanced.

source.title: ANU Programs and Courses 2027, BCOMM: assumed mathematics knowledge

requirements.label: Science preparation and subject-specific prerequisites
requirements.details: The degree has no general subject prerequisite. Some first-year classes and biology majors require chemistry preparation. CHEM1101 can be entered with ACT major-level Chemistry or a bridging course. Check calculus and other prerequisites of the chosen first-year subjects.

source.title: ANU Programs and Courses 2027, BSC: science prerequisites

requirements.label: Pathway diplomas · alternative admission credentials
requirements.details: The pathway accepts an AQF Certificate IV as another entry basis. The programme guides also consider an average of at least 80% in academic subjects of the General Secondary Education Certificate (Tawjihi or Shahadat Al-Thanawaya Al-aama), alongside a qualifying SAT result. ANU procedure specifies Kuwait, the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia or Qatar for the Tawjihi route.

source.title: ANU coursework admissions procedure, pathway diploma qualifications

requirements.label: Pathway diplomas · rank adjustments
requirements.details: ANU excludes the pathway diplomas from all adjustment-factor schemes.

source.title: ANU coursework admissions procedure, Table 2 and pathway diploma exclusions

requirements.label: Optional Design and Visual Arts portfolio
requirements.details: For 2027, Design and Visual Arts accept an optional portfolio. Include a 300–500 word statement and six images of original work with a title, date and up to 50 words of commentary per work. A satisfactory submission may add up to 10 rank points for applicants eligible for the adjustment and with a rank of at least 70.

source.title: ANU additional selection, 2027 Design and Visual Arts portfolio

requirements.label: Flexible double degree · check both component degrees
requirements.details: The listed rank is for the flexible programme category. Meet the rank and subject requirements of both chosen component degrees.

source.title: ANU Programs and Courses 2027, 4855FDD: flexible double degree and course requirements
